name: Tököl (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and blue in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Tököl: a blue shield with a yellow lion and a green mound, inscribed TÖKÖL.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
